```yaml
name: Abuse Detection Cron

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs at midnight UTC every day

jobs:
  abuse-detection:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run abuse detection script
        run: npx tsx scripts/detect-abuse.ts --last 24h --parallel 3 --auto-apply

      - name: Commit changes (if any)
        id: commit_changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          add: '.'
          commit: 'Automated abuse detection and blocking'
          author_name: GitHub Actions
          author_email: actions@github.com
          push: true

      - name: Notify via Slack (optional)
        if: ${{ success() }}
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1
        with:
          slack_token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
          channel_id: ${{ secrets.SLACK_CHANNEL_ID }}
          message: "Abuse detection completed successfully."
```
